newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE BUNKER FINAL REPORT AND PRICES - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE BUNKER FINAL REPORT AND PRICES - AUG 12.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - The Singapore bunker market was steady but is poised to rise as sellers held back their offers after 180-cst cargo traded at $103.50 per tonne. Sellers said volume was thin with more enquiries seen for prompt deliveries over the next few days with shipowners paying up to a $5.00 per tonne premium. 380-cst lots were sold at $105.00 and $105.50 per tonne and 180-cst at $109.50. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870-3093)
